name: rea-reverse-engineering
description: Reverse engineer applications, binaries, websites, and runtime behavior with REA's local MCP tools.

interface.longDescription: Use REA to inspect applications, websites, native binaries, and runtime behavior. REA runs analysis locally and returns evidence and limitations. Native decompilation may require a separately installed Hopper, Ghidra, or IDA provider; other targets have their own tool requirements.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use REA to investigate this application or binary and explain the evidence.
